Subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff: coverage packet + PO routing

Hi Tom —

Thanks for agreeing to set up VeloPayments with Redwood. I want to kick off the procurement onboarding so we can get a PO in place and billing started next month. Below is the minimal evidence and items our procurement team needs to complete vendor setup: 

Required evidence (please upload to the Drive link below or reply with attachments):
- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing General Liability (GL) — min $1M per occurrence
- Professional Liability / E&O certificate — policy limit and effective dates
- Cyber/Privacy coverage certificate (if currently pending, send expected renewal date)
- Completed W-9 (company name must match invoicing entity)
- Vendor banking details or ACH remit form (PDF)

PO and billing steps (what we will do on our side):
- Ben (procurement) will create a PO once COI + W9 are in the vendor file
- Finance requires vendor legal name match and remit details for PO acceptance
- Standard net-30 terms unless otherwise negotiated; if you need different terms flag now
Timeline: we typically need COI + W9 within 5 business days to meet the next billing cycle. If any certificate is expiring soon, please note dates in your reply.

Drive link for uploads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeF-ONBOARD-VeloPayments

Action items:
- Tom / VeloPayments: send COI (GL, E&O, Cyber) + W9 + remit info (reply or upload) — due 2026-04-10
- Ben: once received, generate PO and confirm PO number for Velo
- Marissa: loop in legal if any exceptions to terms are requested

If you have a vendor portal or existing onboarding packet we can pull from, feel free to share that instead of separate files.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Vendor Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Tom — thanks for sending. I reviewed the COI PDF quickly: GL and E&O are good and meet our baseline limits. The cyber certificate shows coverage but it will fall short of our preferred effective date requirement if the renewal isn't processed until 2026-05-01. We can accept a conditional PO with the following conditions: 

- PO issued contingent on updated cyber certificate received by 2026-05-05
- Vendor to provide an invoice referencing PO number within 30 days of service start
- Payment terms: Net 30 unless Velo requests otherwise and provides business justification

Can you also provide the remit/ACH form (bank account + routing) and confirm invoicing email/contact? Once we have W9 and remit info I'll generate PO VPAY-2026-089 and share the PO number.

Ben Carter
